operation_details.item: The user pitched a group of investors in the roadshow.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What is the current status of your investor-readiness work?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives you a stable narrative for the roadshow. Are the underlying numbers aligned with the story?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The financial model has been updated.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Good. With both the narrative and model ready, how are you approaching the investor conversations?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I pitched a group of investors in the roadshow.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That is a useful transition from preparation to market feedback. What is the next step in managing the conversations?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Follow-up meetings are scheduled with several investors.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: You can use those meetings to test which parts of the business opportunity create the strongest engagement and where more evidence is needed.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I want to keep the discussions focused on scaling the company rather than over-polishing the presentation.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That focus can help you learn which strategic questions matter most to potential partners while preserving momentum on execution.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I will use the upcoming conversations to sharpen the company's growth priorities.
